data.body: **[P2] Preserve earlier instances when a later factory fails fatally.** The plugin list is published only after every factory completes. If an earlier built-in OTel factory has already started its Invocation span and a later factory throws `VirtualMachineError` or `ThreadDeath`, `contain` propagates before this assignment. The execution failure path calls `onInvocationEnd`, but the runner still appears empty, so the earlier span is never ended or flushed. Publish `created` before rethrowing a fatal throwable, or explicitly clean up the successfully created instances, and add a regression test with a resource-owning first factory and fatal second factory.
